title: Preventing Trap Siphonage with P-Traps
description: A liquid trap seal in a P-trap acts as a critical barrier that prevents sewer gases from entering living spaces. A common installation error is creating an unvented S-trap. When wastewater rushes down an S-trap's downward leg, it creates a siphoning action that pulls the protective water seal out of the trap dip. Installing a properly vented P-trap ensures air enters the system to break the siphon, preserving the liquid seal. Always maintain a proper trap arm length before connecting to a vented drain line.

Preventing Trap Siphonage with P-Traps

A liquid trap seal in a P-trap acts as a critical barrier that prevents sewer gases from entering living spaces. A common installation error is creating an unvented S-trap. When wastewater rushes down an S-trap's downward leg, it creates a siphoning action that pulls the protective water seal out of the trap dip. Installing a properly vented P-trap ensures air enters the system to break the siphon, preserving the liquid seal. Always maintain a proper trap arm length before connecting to a vented drain line.
